en: Write ALL text content (title, segment names, text overlays, narrative_rationale) in English.
cn: Write ALL text content (title, segment names, text overlays, narrative_rationale) in Chinese (简体中文). Use natural, evocative Chinese — not literal translations from English. Keep text overlays concise (6-12 characters) for readability.
both: Write ALL text content in BOTH languages. Format: "English / 中文". For example: title "Family Adventure / 家庭奇遇", segment name "Wonder & Joy / 惊喜与欢乐", text overlay "Day One / 第一天". Keep both versions concise.
